quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?
questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first. This helps you see the road clearly and stay comfortable. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about dangerous road conditions ahead.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but there is heavy oncoming traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear
Turn because you have a green light

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear
questions.explanation: You can move into the intersection when the light is green. Wait in the center for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow HAWK signal mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop
questions.explanation: HAWK signals are used at pedestrian crossings. A flashing yellow light tells you to slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal
Means the same thing as a regular yellow traffic light
You may turn in the direction the arrow points
A green arrow will appear next

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same thing as a regular yellow traffic light
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on slippery roads?

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden speed changes or sharp turns on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: What should you do first when visibility becomes poor?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down
questions.explanation: Slow down first when you cannot see clearly. This is the most important thing to do when facing dangerous road conditions.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a curve in the road?

options.text: Keep slowing down until you are driving straight
Slow down before the curve and speed up after the middle
Slow down only if the road is wet

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before the curve and speed up after the middle
questions.explanation: Slow down before you reach a curve. Speed up only after you pass the middle of the curve. Going too fast can make your vehicle lose grip and skid.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: Signal as you move into the next lane
Signal 500 feet before on residential streets

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Other vehicles can be hidden there. Signal 100 feet before turning on residential streets and five seconds before changing lanes on highways.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: How should you park uphill on a street with a curb?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake
Turn the front wheels away from the curb
Turn the front wheels toward the curb
Turn the back wheels into the curb

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will not roll into traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when driving to a new place?

options.text: Depend on road signs to find your way
Plan your trip before you start driving
Only know generally where your destination is
Always choose the most direct route

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving
questions.explanation: Plan your trip before you start. Check the location on a map so you know exactly where you are going.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the car to go
In the opposite direction of the skid
In any direction. It does not matter

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the car to go
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the car to go. Once the car straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When should you leave more space than usual between your car and the car ahead?
questions.correctAnswerText: On a hill going upward
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your car when stopped on an uphill slope. If the car in front rolls backward when traffic starts moving, you have room to avoid a crash.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead
It shows directions to cities and towns
It tells you about traffic laws and rules
It warns about road construction ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They tell you about dangerous conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if your car with Anti-Lock Brakes starts to skid on a wet road?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly
Press and hold the gas pedal

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly
questions.explanation: Press the brake pedal firmly and keep holding it. The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) will pump the brakes automatically. Do not pump the brakes yourself, as this turns off the ABS.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane closest to the lane you came from.

questions.question: When do roads become very slippery?

options.text: After rain has been falling for more than an hour
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain
questions.explanation: Roads are very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The rain brings oil from the road surface to the top. Hot weather makes this worse.

questions.question: About how many alcoholic drinks can your body process in one hour?
questions.correctAnswerText: One drink
questions.explanation: Your body processes about one alcoholic drink per hour. How impaired you become depends on how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your weight, whether you have eaten, and your health.

questions.question: If a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what can you do?

options.text: You can still turn, but you must let oncoming cars go first
You cannot turn anymore and must go straight
You still have the right to turn without yielding
You no longer need to turn in that direction

questions.correctAnswerText: You can still turn, but you must let oncoming cars go first
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you can still turn in that direction. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a five-sided sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: School zone ahead.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means there is a school zone. Watch for children and people walking in this area.

questions.question: A car ahead has bright headlights on. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the other car.
Toward the right edge of the road.
Toward the left edge of the road.
Straight ahead in the center of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This protects your eyes from the bright lights and helps you stay on the road.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass other cars going the same direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are turning.
questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines, but not solid lines. You can only cross a solid yellow line when you are turning.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol level are you considered Driving While Ability is Impaired (DWAI)?
questions.correctAnswerText: 0.05 to 0.07 percent
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is the amount of alcohol in your blood. A BAC of 0.05 to 0.07 percent means you are driving while impaired and can face legal penalties.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to get where you are going.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Stay farther back from the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther back from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: In bad weather on wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead of you.
